title: SAL-02 Sales Europe
summary: Active European sales cost centre under unit NBC-MAN-01 and owner IMORGAN, with budget details tracked for FY2026-27.
body:
Cost centre SAL-02 covers Northbridge Cycles' Sales Europe operations within business unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner IMORGAN [^r1]. As of 26 October 2026 09:00, the cost centre is OPEN and active for spending in financial year 2026-27 [^r1][^r2]. For 2026-Q4, it has an allocated budget of £345,000, against which £67,593.34 is committed, leaving £277,406.66 available [^r2].

## Budget and spending

Budget and commitment tracking for SAL-02 is maintained in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]] [^r1][^r2]. For the fourth quarter of 2026 (2026-Q4), financial figures recorded as of 26 October 2026 09:00 stand at:

* **Budget amount:** £345,000 [^r2]
* **Committed spend:** £67,593.34 [^r2]
* **Available budget:** £277,406.66 [^r2]
